entities.name: Zorica Jevremović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zorica Jevremović was a Serbian theatre and video director, playwright, choreographer, intermedia theorist, literary historian and feminist. Her work also included that of a dramaturge in alternative and informal theatrical and film groups.
